scope: Whole original Barn.Unload control flow and normal Beamo/BeamoDecal non-deleting destructors, unchanged native bytes. VertexData reset, Renderable reset, CollisionGeo removal, virtual destructors and string allocator/free are explicit ABI services. Ordered arguments and 131072 pool bytes, all eight prepared records in each table, live counts/dirty/table pointer/selected group bytes are compared. Dynamic services exercise count growth/shrinkage and table replacement. Prepared stack vtable addresses alone are normalized to stable service identities. Complete dependent GPU/collision/string implementations, exceptions and Barn.Load remain open; this is not full-class acceptance.
